confidence_notes: Food anchors are rough, crowd-sourced or dated (2023-2026 sources, mostly not Queretaro-specific). Cappuccino is the best-supported anchor, from Mexico-wide and nearby-city averages. No Queretaro-specific cocktail or wine data was found, so cocktail is derived from the beer anchor (about 2x) and wine from beer (about 1.6x). Meal anchors rest on a few menu and cost-of-living snippets. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates only; no booking pages or listings were inspected. FX uses the RBA observation for 15 October 2026 (0.6955 USD per AUD), which the RBA overview page shows. A 16 October figure appeared in search output but could not be verified, so it was not used.
comparable_city_reasoning: Treated as a mid-sized Mexican city priced somewhat below Mexico City and Guadalajara, with a modest premium in the historic centre and tourist areas. Basis: Mexico-wide and Mexico City/Guadalajara/Puebla cappuccino averages, Expatistan and cost-of-living snippets for Queretaro meals and wine, and Mexico-wide beer price guides. Cocktail and wine anchors use the local beer relationship as a fallback.
